answer: Precondition: no payout until an unrelated peer re-executes the task. Then each unverified claim cuts the reward by a fixed slice, and every submission carries a fresh nonce so a replay cannot count twice. A haven of fifty accounts that attest only to each other produces a ripple of identical hashes a panel can spot in one pass. The farm's cost is fifty re-executions it cannot fake, more than the umber-stained ledger pays out.
